fields.default: Roast days move to Monday and Thursday

fields.name: body
fields.label: Text
fields.default:
From Monday 2 November we will roast twice a week instead of three times. The new roast days are Monday and Thursday, and every order leaves the roastery the morning after.

What changes for you

Orders placed by 2 pm on Sunday ship on Tuesday. Orders placed by 2 pm on Wednesday ship on Friday. An order that arrives after the cut-off simply joins the next roast.

  • Standing orders move to the nearest roast day automatically.
  • The minimum order stays at 5 kg.
  • Prices do not change this year.

Why we are doing this

Two larger batches let us run the roaster at its most efficient load, which cuts our gas use by about a fifth. It also gives Mikael a full day for cupping, which he has been squeezing in between deliveries.

If the new days cause trouble for your café, call me on 031 555 01 42 before the end of the month and we will find a rhythm that works.
